model: Marvel Spidey and His Amazing Friends Light Up 3-Wheel Scooter
description:
The Huffy Marvel Spidey and His Amazing Friends Light-Up 3-Wheel Scooter brings superhero action to every ride. Featuring bold Spider-Man graphics, a Spidey handlebar plaque, and exciting light-up features, this scooter lets young riders imagine joining their favorite web-slinging heroes while enjoying active outdoor fun.
A wide deck illuminated by 42 LED lights creates a dazzling display of red, blue, and white lights that shine with every glide. The colorful light show adds excitement to every neighborhood adventure, making each ride feel like a superhero mission in action.
The stable 3-wheel design helps young riders build balance and confidence as they learn to scoot. A lightweight frame, wide deck, comfortable grips, and 6-inch wheels are sized just right for small riders, while the durable steel frame and smooth PVC wheels provide lasting fun ride after ride. Quick Connect assembly gets little heroes ready for action in minutes.
